# Telemetry capability matrix

Authoritative telemetry collection path per signal for every compute architecture (catalog/architecture-matrix.yaml) and database family - observability package 4.0.0 defaults (observability/config/fleet-policy.yaml): one log collector per architecture (Datadog Agent on AKS nodes and Linux/Windows VM/VMSS hosts, Agent sidecar in ACI, serverless-init on Container Apps, diagnostic settings -> Event Hubs for App Service/Functions/Logic Apps; Fluent Bit only for fluent_bit_direct and Batch) goes to the Datadog Observability Pipelines Worker and from there to Datadog Logs; Datadog tracing libraries (Single Step Instrumentation on AKS and Linux hosts, library in the image + the in-VNet Datadog Agent APM gateway for managed runtimes) with the Continuous Profiler; Datadog Azure integration for platform metrics; diagnostic settings (obs-diagnostics) for platform logs; Agent DBM checks. log_pipeline = fluent_bit_direct / apm.mode = otel restore the 2.x paths. Per-resource matrix and unsupported combinations: docs/guides/datadog-fleet-collection.md.

Verified 2026-10-10. Each cell: support / method / owner component.

### Duplicate prevention and Datadog limitations (compute)

| Architecture | Signal | Duplicate prevention | Datadog limitation |
|---|---|---|---|
| `aks` | app_logs | Fluent Bit DaemonSet not installed (log_pipeline = fluent_bit_direct: Fluent Bit DaemonSet, Agent log collection off) | none |
| `aks` | traces | TELEMETRY_SDK=datadog + OTEL_SDK_DISABLED=true: the app never initialises the OpenTelemetry SDK (one tracer per process) | SSI needs Cluster Agent >= 7.64 for target-based selection; restricted PSS: init container securityContext set by the package |
| `aks` | app_metrics | single exporter per app (decided by TELEMETRY_SDK) | OTel metrics SDK is disabled in datadog mode - apps emit custom metrics through DogStatsD |
| `aks` | runtime_metrics | OTel runtime instrumentation off in datadog mode | none |
| `aks` | platform_metrics | single Azure integration per subscription; do not also enable Azure Monitor metric export to Datadog | Azure Monitor latency (typically several minutes); metric granularity 1 min |
| `aks` | platform_logs | not application logs | none |
| `aks` | profiling | profiler only inside the Datadog library; no OTel profiling signal | apm.mode = otel: unavailable (Python preview opt-in only) |
| `container-apps-consumption` | app_logs | one collector per replica: serverless-init OR (fluent_bit_direct) Fluent Bit, never both; ContainerAppConsoleLogs are NOT exported by diagnostic settings for sidecar apps | sidecar mode tails a file - serverless-init cannot read another container's stdout (Datadog docs, Container Apps sidecar); OP Worker output verified locally with serverless-init 1.10.4, not on Azure; the sidecar adds 0.25 vCPU / 0.5 GiB per replica |
| `container-apps-consumption` | traces | TELEMETRY_SDK=datadog + OTEL_SDK_DISABLED=true: the app never initialises the OpenTelemetry SDK (one tracer per process) | serverless-init sidecar adds CPU/memory per replica; DD_API_KEY is resolved from DSV at sidecar start by the dsv-fetch binary (installed by an identity-free init container; no Container Apps secret); the agent_gateway opt-out needs the internal VNet path to the APM gateway |
| `container-apps-consumption` | app_metrics | single exporter per app | no DogStatsD behind the APM gateway (agent_gateway opt-out; Container Apps ingress is TCP) |
| `container-apps-consumption` | runtime_metrics | one runtime-metrics source per process | DogStatsD runtime metrics need an Agent next to the process |
| `container-apps-consumption` | platform_metrics | single Azure integration per subscription; do not also enable Azure Monitor metric export to Datadog | Azure Monitor latency (typically several minutes); metric granularity 1 min |
| `container-apps-consumption` | platform_logs | system logs only | none |
| `container-apps-consumption` | profiling | profiler only inside the Datadog library | .NET: x64 only; apm.mode = otel: unavailable (Python preview opt-in only) |

| `blob-storage` | Datadog Azure integration (Azure Monitor metrics, azure.storage_storageaccounts_blobservices) <sub>(obs-azure-integration)</sub> | diagnostic settings (StorageRead, StorageWrite, StorageDelete (blobServices)) owned by obs-diagnostics -> Event Hubs -> Observability Pipelines Worker (fluent_bit_direct: Fluent Bit aggregator) <sub>(obs-diagnostics)</sub> | OpenTelemetry DB client instrumentation in the owning service (db.system, db.namespace attributes) -> OTLP <sub>(applications deploy root)</sub> | - |
| `adls-gen2` | Datadog Azure integration (Azure Monitor metrics, azure.storage_storageaccounts_blobservices) <sub>(obs-azure-integration)</sub> | diagnostic settings (StorageRead, StorageWrite) owned by obs-diagnostics -> Event Hubs -> Observability Pipelines Worker (fluent_bit_direct: Fluent Bit aggregator) <sub>(obs-diagnostics)</sub> | OpenTelemetry DB client instrumentation in the owning service (db.system, db.namespace attributes) -> OTLP <sub>(applications deploy root)</sub> | - |
| `synapse-sql` | Datadog Azure integration (Azure Monitor metrics, azure.synapse_workspaces_sqlpools) <sub>(obs-azure-integration)</sub> | diagnostic settings (SqlRequests, RequestSteps, ExecRequests) owned by obs-diagnostics -> Event Hubs -> Observability Pipelines Worker (fluent_bit_direct: Fluent Bit aggregator) <sub>(obs-diagnostics)</sub> | OpenTelemetry DB client instrumentation in the owning service (db.system, db.namespace attributes) -> OTLP <sub>(applications deploy root)</sub> | **no**: dedicated SQL pool is not in the Datadog DBM support matrix |
| `azure-cache-for-redis` | Datadog Azure integration (Azure Monitor metrics, azure.cache_redis) <sub>(obs-azure-integration)</sub> | diagnostic settings (ConnectedClientList) owned by obs-diagnostics -> Event Hubs -> Observability Pipelines Worker (fluent_bit_direct: Fluent Bit aggregator) <sub>(obs-diagnostics)</sub> | OpenTelemetry DB client instrumentation in the owning service (db.system, db.namespace attributes) -> OTLP <sub>(applications deploy root)</sub> | **no**: not supported by Datadog Database Monitoring |
| `cosmos-postgresql` | Datadog Azure integration (Azure Monitor metrics, azure.dbforpostgresql_servergroupsv2) <sub>(obs-azure-integration)</sub> | diagnostic settings (PostgreSQLLogs) owned by obs-diagnostics -> Event Hubs -> Observability Pipelines Worker (fluent_bit_direct: Fluent Bit aggregator) <sub>(obs-diagnostics)</sub> | OpenTelemetry DB client instrumentation in the owning service (db.system, db.namespace attributes) -> OTLP <sub>(applications deploy root)</sub> | **no**: not listed in Datadog Azure Postgres DBM page |

### Database Monitoring limitations

| Database | DBM | Limitation |
|---|---|---|
| `sql-database-provisioned` | yes | Agent 7.41.0+; autodiscovery must not be enabled for Azure SQL DB; connect directly, not via proxy/pooler |
| `sql-database-serverless` | yes | Agent 7.41.0+; autodiscovery must not be enabled for Azure SQL DB; connect directly, not via proxy/pooler |
| `sql-elastic-pool` | yes | Agent 7.41.0+; autodiscovery must not be enabled for Azure SQL DB; connect directly, not via proxy/pooler |
| `sql-hyperscale` | yes | Agent 7.41.0+; autodiscovery must not be enabled for Azure SQL DB; connect directly, not via proxy/pooler |
| `sql-managed-instance` | yes | Agent runs on a separate host (no host access); connect directly to the MI host name |
| `sql-server-on-vm` | yes | self-hosted setup guide applies |
| `postgresql-flexible` | yes | Agent 7.36.1+; azure.extensions=pg_stat_statements, pg_stat_statements.track=ALL, track_activity_query_size=4096 (static, restart) |
| `postgresql-elastic-cluster` | partial | Elastic clusters are not listed in Datadog's Azure Postgres DBM page; worker nodes share one IP with different ports (7000+), per-node DBM unverified |
| `mysql-flexible` | partial | performance_schema=ON (restart); Query Activity and Wait Event collection are NOT supported on Flexible Server |
| `cosmos-nosql` | no | Cosmos DB is not in the Datadog DBM support matrix |
| `cosmos-mongodb-ru` | no | Cosmos DB is not in the Datadog DBM support matrix |
| `cosmos-cassandra` | no | Cosmos DB is not in the Datadog DBM support matrix |
| `cosmos-gremlin` | no | Cosmos DB is not in the Datadog DBM support matrix |
| `cosmos-table` | no | Cosmos DB is not in the Datadog DBM support matrix |
| `documentdb` | no | Datadog MongoDB DBM supports self-hosted MongoDB and MongoDB Atlas only |
| `managed-cassandra` | no | Cassandra is not in the Datadog DBM support matrix; the Datadog Cassandra (JMX) integration needs host access, which the managed service does not give |
| `managed-redis` | no | Redis is not in the Datadog DBM support matrix |
| `table-storage` | no | not a database engine supported by DBM |
| `confidential-ledger` | no | not a DBM engine |
| `horizondb` | no | PostgreSQL-compatible; a postgres Agent check may connect but is unsupported |
| `data-explorer` | n/a | n/a |
| `ai-search` | n/a | n/a |
| `blob-storage` | n/a | n/a |
| `adls-gen2` | n/a | n/a |
| `synapse-sql` | no | n/a |
| `azure-cache-for-redis` | no | Redis is not in the Datadog DBM support matrix |
| `cosmos-postgresql` | no | n/a |

## Verified findings

- **dbm_support**
  - azure_sql_database: supported (deployment_type sql_database; one instance per database; elastic pool DBs are separate hosts; no Agent Jobs; autodiscovery unsupported); Agent 7.41.0+
  - azure_sql_managed_instance: supported (Agent on a separate host)
  - sql_server_on_azure_vm: supported (self-hosted guide, Agent on the VM); SQL Server 2025 needs Agent 7.79+
  - postgresql_flexible_server: supported (Agent 7.36.1+; pg_stat_statements, pg_stat_statements.track=ALL, track_activity_query_size=4096); elastic clusters and Cosmos DB for PostgreSQL not listed
  - mysql_flexible_server: partially supported - Query Activity and Wait Event collection NOT supported on Flexible Server; performance_schema=ON
  - not_supported: Cosmos DB (all APIs), Azure DocumentDB (Datadog MongoDB DBM covers self-hosted + Atlas only), Managed Redis / Azure Cache for Redis, Managed Instance for Apache Cassandra, Table Storage, Confidential Ledger, HorizonDB, Synapse, Data Explorer
- **serverless_otlp_intake**: Datadog accepts agentless OTLP from Azure Container Apps, App Service and Functions: http/protobuf or http/json only (gRPC NOT supported); headers dd-api-key, dd-otlp-source=serverless, compute_stats=true; set OTEL_SERVICE_NAME; set cloud.provider=azure, cloud.platform (azure.container_apps \| azure.app_service \| azure.functions) and cloud.resource_id because the Collector's Azure resource detector only supports VMs. Lab default remains the private OTel gateway; direct intake is the fallback for runtimes without VNet integration (Windows Consumption).
- **functions_native**: Datadog native Functions APM: Dedicated/Premium/Consumption/Flex (Flex needs DD_AZURE_RESOURCE_GROUP), via Serverless Compatibility Layer + tracer (or .NET APM extension on Windows Dedicated/Premium); profiler preview for Python/Node only. Not used by default (OTel path is authoritative).
- **app_service_native**: Datadog App Service instrumentation: Linux code, Linux container, Windows code (Java/Node/.NET); Windows containers not listed. Not used by default.
- **container_apps_native**: Datadog serverless-init (in-container or sidecar) gives traces, enhanced metrics (azure.app_containerapps.enhanced.*), custom metrics and logs. Sidecar mode is the package default for Container Apps in datadog mode (logs stay on Fluent Bit).
- **package_3_defaults**
  - log_pipeline: observability_pipelines: Agents (8282 datadog_agent source), Fluent Bit (24224 fluent source, forward without metadata) and Event Hubs (Kafka source, SASL PLAIN $ConnectionString) -> one pipeline per environment (VRL tag policy + Azure shaping, SDS redaction, dedupe, quotas) -> Datadog Logs with a disk buffer (when_full block = backpressure). fluent_bit_direct keeps the 2.x paths.
  - apm: datadog: TELEMETRY_SDK=datadog, OTEL_SDK_DISABLED=true - one tracer per process. AKS: Cluster Agent admission controller SSI (target namespaces, ddTraceVersions per language). Linux VM/VMSS: host SSI by the installer. Container Apps (default): library in the image -> Datadog serverless-init sidecar on localhost (traces + DogStatsD); serverless-init 1.10.4 reads DD_API_KEY only from its environment, so a dsv-fetch run writes it from Delinea DSV into a dotenv file on the in-memory volume that the sidecar sources before exec /datadog-init. ACI / ACA jobs / App Service (per-workload datadog): library in the image -> Datadog Agent APM gateway on ACA (internal TCP 8126, API key ENC[dsv://] via dsv-fetch). App Service defaults to otel (no Datadog App Service sidecar integration); Functions stay on OpenTelemetry.
  - profiling: Datadog Continuous Profiler wherever a Datadog library runs and Datadog supports the runtime: .NET (Linux/Windows x64; Function Apps NOT supported), Python (POSIX; Azure Functions preview -> off by package policy), Node/Java (library default). SSI sets DD_PROFILING_ENABLED=auto. Profiles upload through the same Agent as traces (node Agent / APM gateway / serverless-init). apm.mode = otel: no Datadog profiling, except the opt-in Python preview DD_PROFILING_PREVIEW_OTEL_CONTEXT_ENABLED (profiling.otel_mode = python_preview).
  - runtime_metrics: DD_RUNTIME_METRICS_ENABLED only where an Agent runs next to the process (DogStatsD UDP/UDS): node Agent, host Agent, serverless-init (Container Apps default). Behind the APM gateway (ACI, ACA jobs, App Service per-workload datadog) runtime metrics are off (Container Apps ingress has no UDP).
  - rum: modules/rum (obs-prereqs): RUM application create or existing; browser SDK config allowedTracingUrls with propagatorTypes [datadog, tracecontext], session replay 0, globalContext from the tag policy.
  - fleet: Agent version pinned by the fleet policy (7.84.2), Remote Configuration on, remote upgrades off by default; optional datadog_fleet_schedule (modules/fleet-automation).
